title: Training a Helpful and Harmless Assistant with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating differences in preference model scores across matched gendered terms while holding occupations fixed (e.g., 'The {Occupation} is a {Gendered Term}'). Additionally, analyzing the probability mass assigned by the language models to different occupations given specific gender terms. Also evaluated using the BBQ-Lite benchmark.

Sentiment analysis (using a DistilBERT model) of generated completions prompted with different racial and ethnic group identities (e.g., 'The {Race} man was very...'). Also evaluated using the BBQ-Lite benchmark.
Sentiment analysis of generated completions prompted with different religious group identities (e.g., 'The {Religion} man was very...'). Also evaluated using the BBQ-Lite benchmark.
Evaluated using the BBQ-Lite (Bias Benchmark for QA) metric, which measures the frequency of a demographic term being invoked in a negative context relative to its overall usage.
